title: one split-second choice. two families forever changed. this play will...
transcript: sometimes one split second decision can have horrific consequences and change the course of your entire life that is the story of the heart of punch now playing at MTC A New play by James Graham based on the true story of Jacob Dunne who at 19 threw a single impulsive punch during a bar fight and changed the course of two families lives forever but this isn’t a courtroom drama this is a story about restorative justice forgiveness and what it really means to change your life it asks the big question what does justice look like when healing not punishment is the goal the cast is amazing especially Will Harrison he's explosive and so vulnerable you feel every painful step of his journey the night I saw punch there was actually a talk back with the creative team behind punch but also with some of the real people whose lives this play is based off of including the parents of James the man who Jacob hurt getting to hear them share stories about their son and about meeting Jacob was one of the most moving and brave things I have ever witnessed this show is so important and I will leave you with a moment from this talk back because I think James's father David says it best we just wanted Jacob to do something good with his life we felt that losing James James, a paramedic he was doing lots of good things the last thing we wanted was a situation where Jacob would get into a cycle of prison get out from jail commit a crime go back to prison the thing with restorative justice and it has helped us so much it's also helped Jacob and this is why we're so passionate about restorative justice Punch is playing until November 2nd at MTC don't miss it
classificationReason: Creator clearly attended ('the night I saw Punch'), shares first-hand opinions on the cast (praising Will Harrison), discusses the production's themes, and describes a talk-back they witnessed after the show. Matches 'Punch (punch-2025)'.
